summary: Narrow tree-shaded residential street with homes 12-20 m away on both sides.

best_section.where: Mid-block under the tree canopy, between the two cross streets

drivers.seclusion: Dense houses on both sides; nearest dwellings 12 m (east) and 15 m (west), none within 10 m of this section.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane with trees along the edge; a couple of cars park on the west side, room is tight for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end style residential street, low traffic.
drivers.convention: Some residents park along it but no sign of overnight vans.

flags: Steep overall: about 8% mean, 20% max grade
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy shades the section, mostly from the east and west.
